sample_unit: clinician survey respondents at baseline (172, 117, 101 at 1-, 3-, 6-month follow-up)

links.outcome: Clinician documentation time, workload, and burnout after ambient AI scribe deployment using validated instruments
links.effect: Reduced mental demand, time pressure, documentation effort (p<0.05); more clinicians reporting <2 hours/day outside-clinic documentation; burnout increased across follow-up (p<0.05).
links.quote: Clinicians reported statistically significant reductions in mental demand, time pressure, and documentation effort at postimplementation intervals (p < 0.05).

screen.reason: Prospective repeated cross-sectional study evaluating the real-world deployment and clinician workload impact of ambient AI scribes over 6 months.
